caption.text:
Thank you @kneesovertoesguy for this amazing opportunity, it's time to be the person I needed when I was looking for a way to increase my athletic potential and performance way back in 2008. It was the first time I thought of nutrition or any sort of exercise routine. I've been studying everything possible since then. 
Your words and no hate policy really stands out and resonates since day one. Now I hope to join every coach that wants to leave a mark and help people get out of pain. 

Thank you to @keegancoach  the best mentor I could ever ask for. I cannot really put into words what your support means to me . 
Thank you @kneesovertoesgirl 
@franzofmotion @theatgcoach 
@atgexercise @atg_sensei @ianirby 
My gratitude goes to all of my students, it's been a pleasure serving you. I sincerely appreciate every human I ever trained. 

Thank you my #wolf it's been an awesome journey and it's just getting started. Your dedication makes me a better human every day.

Your body will thank you in ten years for what you're doing today.
Bulgarian split squats to build single-leg strength and expose imbalances before they become injuries. Nordic curls to build hamstring strength. This is how you stay in the fight, on the mat, or just moving well for life.
No shortcuts. Just consistent, intentional work.
